sources.title: How Russell Wilson reacted to Giants’ Jaxson Dart injury crusher
sources.description: During Tuesday's installment of "Set, Hut!" on CBS Sports, the veteran quarterback, who spent the 2025 season with Big Blue, reacted to an ESPN report that Dart might need season-ending surgery.
